recommendation: Keep the FHIR-55651 audit commit as-is. Do not restore extensible strength unless OO or a final cross-resource binding governance decision explicitly reverses the resource-specific decision.
issue_request: FHIR-55651 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 request to change NutritionOrder.additive.routeOfAdministration and NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.routeOfAdministration from extensible to preferred because the code system may not be used by all jurisdiction or implementation communities.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 16d8302a3ea642490d8f3b57b66d02e25eccb9dd, which changed both affected route binding strengths from extensible to preferred in source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml. The FHIR-55651 Jira comments cite that commit.
additional_context: FHIR-55651 is related to the broader FHIR-54613 binding review, but that issue remains Triaged/unresolved and does not supersede this resource-specific OO decision. FHIR-46924 introduced the additive route element and original extensible binding that FHIR-55651 later refined.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source uses preferred strength for both affected NutritionOrder route bindings while retaining the Enteral Route Codes value set.

related_jiras.note: Introduced NutritionOrder.additive.routeOfAdministration with the original extensible Enteral Route Codes binding that FHIR-55651 later refined.
